newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George prices U.S. capital raising.
newsitem.headline: St George prices U.S. capital raising.

text.p: Acquisitive regional bank St George Bank Ltd said on Friday that it had priced a capital raising in the U.S. markets that would raise US$250 million (A$333 million).
"The Capital Security, the first of its kind by an Australian company, is a perpetual security which has an initial non-cumulative dividend of 8.485 percent," St George said.
St George said it could call the security after 10 years.
"The Reserve Bank of Australia has classified this security as Tier 1 capital for the St George Bank Group," St George said, adding the issue was sole managed by Merrill Lynch & Co.
"This form of Tier 1 security, which has a fixed coupon, represents low cost capital which can provide issuing banks with return on equity and earnings per share benefits," it said.
The Capital Securities have been rated Baal, BBB plus and BBB plus by Moody's Investor Services, Standard and Poor's and IBCA Ltd respectively.
The capital raising was initially planned to fund an aborted takeover bid for Metway Bank Ltd last year, but was eventually needed to fund the now-completed merger with Advance Bank Ltd this year.
St George's shares were three cents lower at A$8.08 at 1.15 p.m. (0315 GMT).
